mistakes.title: Package registry rate-limited or flaked (environment, not code)
mistakes.rule: HTTP 429/5xx or connection resets from Maven Central / crates.io are environment flakes: the harness retries with backoff. Never change versions or code because of them.
mistakes.fix: Re-run; Gradle/cargo caches what already downloaded.

mistakes.title: Money represented as floating point
mistakes.rule: Money is always integer minor units (paise) in i64 (Rust) / Long (Kotlin). Never f32/f64/Float/Double for amounts, caps, totals or values; percentages are integer basis points.
mistakes.fix: Change the type to i64/Long `*_minor` and format only at the UI edge (formatInr).

mistakes.title: Reading the wall clock inside pure core logic
mistakes.rule: hearth-core and android/core are pure: never call Utc::now/Local::now/SystemTime::now/Instant.now/LocalDate.now/System.currentTimeMillis there. Pass `now`/`anchor` in as a parameter (or a Clock) so tests are deterministic.
mistakes.fix: Add a `now: i64` (epoch millis) or `anchor: NaiveDate/LocalDate` parameter and supply it from the server/app layer.

mistakes.title: SQL built with string formatting
mistakes.rule: Never build SQL with format!/string templates. Use bound parameters (`?1`, `params![]`) for every value.
mistakes.fix: Replace the interpolated value with a `?N` placeholder and pass it in params![].

mistakes.title: unwrap()/expect() in request-handling server code
mistakes.rule: Server code (hearth-server/src, outside tests and main startup) must propagate errors as ApiError instead of unwrap()/expect(); a panic kills the request and can poison the DB mutex.
mistakes.fix: Use `?` with `ApiError` (From impls exist for rusqlite/serde errors).

mistakes.title: Raw SMS text logged or uploaded
mistakes.rule: Raw SMS bodies never leave the parser: do not log them and never put them in a synced payload. Only parsed amount, merchant, category, last4 and reference may be stored or synced.
mistakes.fix: Log only the parse outcome (e.g. `parsed=true merchant=...`).

mistakes.title: Rust code not formatted with rustfmt
mistakes.rule: Run `cargo fmt --all` (in backend/) after editing Rust.
mistakes.fix: cd backend && cargo fmt --all

mistakes.title: Unused import/variable/function (clippy -D warnings)
mistakes.rule: Remove unused imports, variables and dead code before finishing; prefix intentionally unused bindings with `_`.
mistakes.fix: Delete the unused item or use it.

mistakes.title: Clippy lint violation
mistakes.rule: Write idiomatic Rust that passes `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` (needless borrows, redundant clones, manual impls, etc.).
mistakes.fix: Apply the suggestion printed under `help:`.
patterns: error: .*\n(.*\n){0,12}.*= help: for further information visit https://rust-lang.github.io/rust-clippy

mistakes.title: Borrow checker / ownership error
mistakes.rule: Think about ownership before writing Rust: clone small values deliberately, borrow for reads, and don't hold a MutexGuard across .await.
mistakes.fix: Read the E-code explanation (`rustc --explain E0xxx`).

mistakes.title: Rust type mismatch / missing trait / unresolved item
mistakes.rule: Check exact types (i64 vs u64, &str vs String, Option wrapping) and imports before compiling; derive the traits (Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, PartialEq) the call sites need.
mistakes.fix: Follow the compiler note; add the missing derive/import/conversion.

mistakes.title: Cargo.lock out of date for --locked builds
mistakes.rule: After changing dependencies run `cargo generate-lockfile`/`cargo build` and commit Cargo.lock.
mistakes.fix: cd backend && cargo build && git add Cargo.lock
patterns: the lock file .* needs to be updated but --locked was passed

mistakes.title: Rust test assertion failed
mistakes.rule: When a Rust test fails, decide whether the test or the code is wrong from the spec (contracts/ + docs/architecture.md); never edit expected values just to make it pass.
mistakes.fix: Run `cargo test <name> -- --nocapture` and compare left/right.

mistakes.title: Implementation disagrees with a shared contract fixture
mistakes.rule: contracts/*.json is the single source of truth for behaviour shared by Rust and Kotlin. Change the fixture first (with a reason), then make BOTH implementations pass.
mistakes.fix: Run the contract test in both stacks: `cargo test contract` and `./gradlew :core:test --tests '*Contract*'`.

mistakes.title: Kotlin unresolved reference / missing import
mistakes.rule: Import what you use and keep package names in sync with directories (com.hearth.core.*).
mistakes.fix: Add the import or fix the package declaration.

mistakes.title: Kotlin type mismatch / nullability error
mistakes.rule: Respect nullability (String? vs String) and numeric types (Int vs Long) explicitly; amounts are Long so use `0L` literals.
mistakes.fix: Add the conversion or null handling the compiler asks for.
patterns: e: .*(Type mismatch|Argument type mismatch|Only safe \(\?\.\) or non-null asserted|None of the following (candidates|functions) is applicable|Return type mismatch|The integer literal does not conform)

mistakes.title: Kotlin/JUnit test assertion failed
mistakes.rule: When a JUnit test fails, read the expected/actual diff and check the spec before changing anything; never weaken the assertion.
mistakes.fix: Open android/core/build/reports/tests/test/index.html or rerun with --info.

mistakes.title: Gradle could not resolve a dependency or plugin
mistakes.rule: Only use dependency versions that exist on Maven Central / Gradle Plugin Portal / Google Maven, declared in android/gradle/libs.versions.toml. Android (AGP/androidx) artifacts need Google Maven, which may be blocked offline.
mistakes.fix: Check the coordinate/version; keep JVM-only modules free of androidx dependencies.

mistakes.title: Harness self-test failure
mistakes.rule: The harness is code too: change harness/tests first, keep it stdlib-only (Python 3.11).
mistakes.fix: cd harness && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v

mistakes.title: Crate API used without enabling its cargo feature
mistakes.rule: Before using an optional crate API, enable its feature in Cargo.toml (clap: env/derive, tokio: macros/rt-multi-thread/fs/time, chrono: clock/serde, serde: derive, tower: util). A 'not found' error on a third-party item usually means a missing feature, not a typo.
mistakes.fix: Add the feature to the dependency in Cargo.toml (e.g. clap = { features = ["derive", "env"] }).
patterns: no method named `env` found for struct `Arg`
no function or associated item named `now` found for struct `Utc`

mistakes.title: Kotlin code not ktlint-clean (or not parseable)
mistakes.rule: Kotlin in android/ must pass `./gradlew ktlintCheck` (it also proves :app parses where the SDK is missing). Run `./gradlew ktlintFormat` after editing Kotlin.
mistakes.fix: cd android && ./gradlew ktlintFormat
